meta.title: LAVAALL Web | Websites and automation for West African businesses
meta.description: Websites, animated storefronts and AI automation for restaurants, hotels, shops and marketers in Sierra Leone, Guinea and Liberia.

hero.h1: Your business, online and answering for you.
hero.sub: We build fast websites and automations for restaurants, hotels, shops and marketers in Sierra Leone, Guinea and Liberia.

work.sub: Four real projects. Each one is running or has a working build.

items.name: LAVAALL
items.text: Browse by category, brand and model, then request a quote for any item. Built for a distributor selling IT, electrical and cooling equipment.

items.name: LAVAALL Starlink
items.text: An image-first concept for selling satellite internet kits. Few words, big pictures, one clear path to a quote. A design concept, not a live store.

items.name: Hermes OS
items.text: Eleven specialised agents handle email, calendar, finance, memory and research from one dashboard and a Telegram chat. Agents draft; a person approves before anything is sent.

items.name: Portfolio
items.text: A single-page React site with project write-ups and certifications, deployed live.

morph.text: The same page adapts to desktop, tablet and phone. Most of your customers will see it on a phone, so we design that one first.

notes.desktop: Wide layout: navigation and the main button are visible at once.
notes.tablet: The layout narrows and spacing adapts.
notes.phone: One column, with large buttons within thumb reach.

demos.sub: These are illustrations of how an automation runs. They are not live connections.

items.title: Post for you
steps: New photos land in a folder
Posts go to Instagram and your Facebook Page
items.result: A week of posts, ready in minutes.

items.title: Write your listings
steps: Listing is added to your shop catalogue
items.result: New stock online the same day.

items.title: Answer customers
steps: Agent checks your menu, rooms or prices
Sends a reply, or asks you

items.title: Weekly check-up
items.result: You see where you are losing sales.

demos.trust: Agents draft. You approve. Nothing is posted or sent without your say-so.

capabilities.h2: What we can set up for you
capabilities.sub: Pick one, or build up to a full business system.
capabilities.videoNote: Short loops show how each one works.

items.title: Instagram and WhatsApp replies
items.text: Answers common questions from your menu, rooms or catalogue, and passes the rest to you.

items.title: Social posting
items.text: Captions and a posting calendar drafted for you. You approve.

items.title: Lead finder
items.text: Builds a list of businesses and buyers near you and scores who to contact first.

items.title: Search visibility
items.text: Gets your business showing when people search for what you sell.

items.title: Shop support agent
items.text: Answers order and delivery questions for your online shop.

items.title: Natural-sounding writing
items.text: Final pass so captions and replies read like you wrote them.

items.title: Inbox and replies
items.text: Sorts messages and drafts answers.

items.title: Quotes, invoices and documents
items.text: Makes a quote or invoice from your template in seconds.

items.title: Invoice chasing
items.text: Flags unpaid invoices and drafts polite reminders.

items.title: Competitor and price watch
items.text: Checks rivals and tells you in one paragraph what changed.

items.title: Customer feedback
items.text: Reads your reviews and flags the complaints first.

items.title: Hiring helper
items.text: Writes the job post and scores applicants against the role. You decide.

os.h2: A business system, not just a website
os.sub: Modelled on how Hermes OS runs: separate agents, one dashboard, you approve the important moves.

modules.name: Daily brief
modules.text: A short morning summary of sales and risks.

modules.name: Money
modules.text: Costs and cash in one view. It never moves money.

modules.name: Market watch
modules.text: Rival prices and what people are searching for.

region.h2: Built for how people here use the web
region.sub: Most visitors are on phones, and data costs money.

points.title: Light pages
points.text: Designed to load quickly on slow connections. We will publish the measured numbers once the build is tested.

points.title: Any device, same feel
points.text: Opens in the browser on any phone, tablet or laptop. No app to install, and it looks and feels the same everywhere.
